##### Project general facts

Azizi Ruby by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with elegant glass balconies and a striking golden-toned facade that blends harmoniously with the surrounding greenery. Clean lines and a refined palette give the building a warm, modern presence within a popular family community. It rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and four podium levels to thirteen residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with retail units.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym and a yoga area for an active daily routine, while a clubhouse, a cosy cinema, a billiards area, relaxation zones and a children's play area add variety for families. A welcoming lobby, lifts, covered parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance provide everyday comfort and peace of mind, and retail units at ground level bring convenience to the doorstep.

Every home is carefully planned for comfortable family living, with panoramic windows that fill the interiors with natural light and enhance the sense of space. Modern finishes and efficient layouts create practical, welcoming homes for couples and growing families. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a vibrant, family-friendly community at the centre of the city, known for its circular layout of landscaped parks, low- and mid-rise residential buildings and townhouses. Circle Mall, the community park network, neighbourhood cafes, supermarkets, nurseries, schools and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the area a green, relaxed character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect residents with the wider city. Circle Mall is a short walk or drive away, Dubai Hills Mall, City Centre Me'aisem and Dubai Media City are close by, and Expo City Dubai, Palm Jumeirah, Business Bay, the Jebel Ali Free Zone and Ibn Battuta Mall are within comfortable reach.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular rental markets in Dubai. A central position between the coastal districts and the inland business hubs attracts young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy and steady demand. Well-finished homes with resort-style amenities and competitive prices underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
